title: Fuzzer: `XRVRS.make_vrs_texture` crashes Godot
body:

- 4.8.dev.custom_build (2c089e9bf)

### System information

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable790 = ClassDB.instantiate("XRVRS")
	temp_variable790.make_vrs_texture(Vector2(0.11154118925333, -0.99375981092453), PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-48.5484962463379, -60.4186668395996), Vector2(8.22689533233643, -37.3047485351562), Vector2(-0.73396641016006, 0.67918574810028), Vector2(-49.9023666381836, -33.2064018249512), Vector2(-83.6870193481445, 65.4549331665039), Vector2(0.96618092060089, -0.25786504149437), Vector2(-0.56004971265793, -0.82845896482468), Vector2(-53.3550872802734, -20.4595928192139), Vector2(57.0001373291016, 43.4342041015625), Vector2(-36.6647109985352, -63.480094909668), Vector2(-93.3487319946289, 81.4589157104492), Vector2(88.7264099121094, -79.3534317016602), Vector2(0.99929916858673, 0.03743294626474), Vector2(-0.90547692775726, -0.42439556121826), Vector2(-91.1883010864258, 89.870361328125), Vector2(-0.77768492698669, 0.6286541223526), Vector2(-84.9540710449219, 2.96506881713867), Vector2(-35.6457481384277, -27.9618911743164), Vector2(-53.0826721191406, -43.7375564575195), Vector2(0.88709825277328, 0.46158072352409), Vector2(-0.9738028049469, 0.22739404439926), Vector2(-92.4445266723633, -43.5734405517578), Vector2(0.0, 0.0), Vector2(-0.72717577219009, 0.68645131587982), Vector2(-0.10379609465599, 0.99459862709045)]))

	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```
